definitions.explanation: The general concept of time, or a period/amount of time. {時間|じかん}がない (no time), {時間|じかん}がかかる (takes time).
Used as a counter for hours. {三時間|さんじかん} (three hours).

⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧{時間|じかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦なら→なら：09575_nara⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{時間|じかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。

examples.english: It takes about two and a half hours from Tokyo to Osaka by bullet train.

notes:
{時間|じかん} has two primary uses: as a general noun meaning "time" and as a counter for hours.

SENSE 1 - TIME (GENERAL):
- {時間|じかん}がある/ない: to have/not have time
- {時間|じかん}がかかる: to take time
- {時間|じかん}を{無駄|むだ}にする: to waste time

SENSE 2 - COUNTER (HOURS):
- {一時間|いちじかん}: one hour
- {二時間|にじかん}: two hours
- {何時間|なんじかん}: how many hours?

KEY DISTINCTION:
- {三時|さんじ}: 3 o'clock (clock time)
- {三時間|さんじかん}: 3 hours (duration)

SPECIAL USAGE:
{時間|じかん} can mean "class period" in school: {一時間目|いちじかんめ} (first period)

COMPARE:
- {時間|じかん}: time (general), hours (duration)
- {時|とき}: time, moment, when
